featured_reviews.name: Pratyush Mohite
featured_reviews.review_text:
Every student has a different perspective about college. What may seem bad to one student might be perfectly fine for another. However, as a recent 12th pass-out who studied at Tolani College during both 11th and 12th grade, I can confidently say that my experience was excellent.

If you are genuinely interested in studies and willing to learn, Tolani College is one of the best places you can choose. The quality of teaching is impressive and, in my opinion, often better than many coaching classes that charge several times more than the college fees.

One of the biggest strengths of this college is its teachers. I was fortunate to learn from supportive and dedicated teachers such as Sangeeta Ma'am and especially Melba Ma'am, who guided me tremendously in Mathematics. Their patience, teaching methods, and willingness to help students made a huge difference in my academic journey.

The college has experienced teachers for different subjects, each bringing their own teaching style and positive attitude to the classroom. Beyond academics, the college also organizes meaningful competitions and activities that help students develop confidence, skills, and memorable experiences.

My advice to future students is simple: attend lectures regularly, interact with your teachers, and don't hesitate to ask questions whenever you have doubts. The faculty is genuinely supportive and willing to help students who show interest in learning.

As for some of the negative reviews online, I believe many of them come from students who rarely attended lectures or had issues due to their own behavior and expectations. While everyone is entitled to their opinion, my personal experience was overwhelmingly positive

featured_reviews.review_text:
My college has always stood out because of its strong infrastructure and well-planned campus environment. From spacious classrooms to well-equipped labs, everything is designed to make the learning experience smooth and productive. The campus atmosphere is clean, disciplined, and student-friendly. You genuinely feel like you're part of a professional and growing institution the moment you step inside.

Being from the Computer Science department, I had a very positive academic journey. The department is known for its dedicated faculty, supportive staff, and the practical exposure it provides to students. Teachers are approachable and always ready to help, whether it’s about assignments, projects, or career guidance. Other departments also maintain the same level of discipline and commitment, which reflects the overall quality of the college.

One thing I really appreciate about the college is the variety of events and activities it organizes throughout the year. Large festivals, technical events, cultural programs, and guest sessions with well-known personalities make the environment lively and inspiring. These events don’t just entertain students—they help us grow, network, and learn beyond the syllabus. The placement opportunities provided are also helpful for students who want to start their career right after graduation.

If there is one challenge, it is the college’s distance from the nearest station. Traveling daily can be tiring for many students because of the long commute. The canteen also has scope for improvement. But apart from these minor issues, the overall experience is truly valuable. The college has given me strong academic knowledge, great memories, and a sense of confidence for the future. I genuinely believe it’s a great place for students who want quality education and a supportive environment.
